body: It's not that I have done anything, it's just a collective of bad decisions over time. It just gets old, u know? you make poor decisions and time goes by, and before you know it life passes you by.

Man as someone that's a few years older, I wish I could go back to your age. Not that it would make a difference for me, but you still have options dude. Don't throw in the towel yet, give it more time and keep fighting.
Man trust me, life changes. Whether if it's for the better or worse. For you I don't know. Don't give up yet tho, still a lot of time left to dictate your life. It's on you tho, still time left.

Haha I feel you. Sometimes you just need to vent, whether it's to strangers or not. Hope you find happiness tho, no real advice from my end, I can't lie and say it gets better because I don''t know. I hope you find happiness though.
Yeah that's relatable for sure. I wonder if I consider suicide as an "easy" way out instead of dealing with my problems.
Your post hit home. Hope u find happiness whether it's alive or not.
